concerns.text: Tasks T009a-d claim to update spec.md to replace ds000115 with ds000246 and fix statistical methods, yet the provided spec.md still contains the old dataset (ds000115) and paired-sample t-test. This is a silent relaxation of the 'Single Source of Truth' (Constitution Principle IV) and 'Statistical Analysis Transparency' (Principle VII) because the task deliverable (the updated spec) is missing, leaving the project in a contradictory state.

Constitution Principle VII explicitly mandates a 'group-level paired-sample t-test', but the tasks (T024, T027) and plan implement a 'one-sample t-test against zero'. The tasks do not include a task to amend the Constitution itself to reflect this methodological change, creating a direct violation of the project's governing constraints.

Task T005 enforces a hard error if the 'Auditory' label is absent, but the Constitution (Principle VI) and Plan reference 'ds000115' (HCP) which lacks the specific 'delayed'/'pitch-shifted' labels required by the new dataset (ds000246). The task list fails to include a prerequisite task to update the Constitution's dataset reference, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' principle.

Task T007 sets up Docker for fmriprep but does not explicitly enforce the 6GB RAM limit mandated by the Plan ('Memory: fmriprep strictly limited to 6GB'). Omitting this constraint in the task implementation risks violating the 'Computational Feasibility' constraint defined in the plan.
